description: Defines the UDPSocketPosix class for UDP socket operations on POSIX systems, including socket management, data transmission, multicast, and socket options.

classes.name: UDPSocketPosix
classes.description: Manages UDP socket operations on POSIX systems, including opening, binding, connecting, reading, writing, multicast, socket options, and logging.

classes.name: ReceivedActivityMonitor
classes.description: Helper class for batching throughput samples for net::activity_monitor, with methods to increment bytes, flush, and handle timer events.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a UDP socket with the specified address family.

methods.name: BindToNetwork
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specific network handle.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects the socket to a remote endpoint.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a local address/port.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends data to a specified address.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the socket's receive buffer size.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the socket's send buffer size.

methods.name: SetDoNotFragment
methods.description: Sets the socket to not fragment packets.

methods.name: AllowAddressSharingForMulticast
